approach: Android port of Goemon 64: Recompiled (N64Recomp static recompilation) with RT64 Vulkan rendering
help: Testing on Mali and other non-Adreno GPUs
notes: Plays natively on Android 9+ arm64 devices with a Vulkan GPU. Analog camera, autosave, save import, on-screen touch controls and a per-app Adreno GPU driver loader. Tested mainly on Retroid Pocket 5 and AYN Thor. Bring your own US cartridge; no game data ships in the APK.
